# Introduction

<!--In this section you explain what you are trying to show.  Where did the data come from?  What is the research or other question you are trying to answer?.  If you skimp in this section expect to be marked down in your grade. Paint a picture of the project a couple of paragraphs is expected!-->

A new  preventative aides drug (triUmpsal) is under test in clinical trials. Consider only the females, does this drug seem effective?  Hint - use dplyr to obtain that sub population with the filter command.

The question is whether the drug triUmpsal appears to make a difference when compared with a placebo. The focus is on female participants in the clinical trial. By comparing the infection outcomes of females who received and the likelihood of becoming infected. To determine the data provides evidence that triUmpsal may be an effective preventative treatment for females. 

$H_0$ There is no relationship between treatment either triUmpsal or placebo and infection status among female participants.   
$H_A$ There is no relationship between treatment either triUmpsal or placebo and infection status among female participants.  

```{r}
female <- triUmp %>%
filter(gender == "F")

names(female)

table(female$treatment)
```

# Methods

We use two categorical variables. Treatment identifies whether female participants received triUmpsal or a placebo. Infection status whether participants became infected with AIDS or remained uninfected. 

categorical - treatment 
categorical - infection status
